translated_comment: For all those who don't understand the problem (frighteningly many, as I gather from the comments): there is no place for racism in Germany. Germany stands for equality. In the past, there were shops, restrooms, etc. for certain groups of people, which was absolute nonsense even back then, and we should never go back to that. If a store owner wants to express his political opinion (which is his good right!), he can do so without discrimination. For example, flags are one option, but also legal slogans, caricatures, symbols, clothing, or he sells corresponding products.
